prompt_text: How to launch a monthly giving program
response_text:
# How to Launch a Monthly Giving Program

Based on best practices from nonprofit fundraising experts, here's a comprehensive guide to launching a successful monthly giving program:

## Phase 1: Foundation & Planning

**Build Internal Support**
- Secure leadership and board buy-in before launch
- Assign a dedicated team member or person to lead the program
- Set measurable yet attainable goals

**Know Your Audience**
- Analyze your existing donor base and journey
- Target donors who already give multiple times per year
- Consider lapsed donors (2-3 years inactive) who may appreciate recurring options
- Exclude major gift prospects from this cultivation stream

**Set Clear Goals**
- Define what you want to achieve (e.g., capture X new monthly donors)
- Decide if funds support a specific program or general operations
- Use consistent messaging across all channels to reinforce goals

## Phase 2: Design Your Offer

**Create a Compelling Value Proposition**
- Explain why monthly donations matter and the impact they'll create
- Focus messaging on mission impact rather than the mechanics of giving
- Define special benefits for recurring donors (exclusive updates, impact reports, recognition)

**Establish Giving Levels**
- Offer 3-5 featured giving levels with clear impact statements
- Show exactly what each donation amount accomplishes (e.g., "$10/month provides...")
- Always include a custom/flexible giving amount option
- Start with lower entry points to make commitment less intimidating

**Test Before Launching**
- Share your offer with 10-20 core donors and volunteers for feedback
- Refine based on responses before full rollout

## Phase 3: Build Technical Infrastructure

**Set Up the Right Tools**
- Choose fundraising software that supports recurring giving (payment processing, management dashboards)
- Ensure your system can handle recurring payment management
- Enable donors to manage their giving frequency, amount, and payment info independently

**Optimize Your Donation Form**
- Make forms mobile-friendly and streamlined to increase conversion
- Include all donation form fields: frequency, start date, amount, payment information
- Add monthly giving options to ALL existing donation forms
- Consider forms that encourage one-time donors to convert to monthly giving

**Create a Dedicated Website Presence**
- Build a dedicated landing page for your monthly giving program
- Include: program name, promise, giving levels, key messages
- Add one compelling image or short video showing hope, safety, or transformation
- Keep the design clean and professional

## Phase 4: Soft Launch & Testing

**Recruit Early Adopters**
- Identify 25 top prospects (donors, volunteers, board members) to be "founders"
- Personally invite them to be exclusive program founders
- Celebrate their commitment with special recognition

**Run a 3-Month Test Phase**
- Use high-touch, personal communications to recruit loyalists
- Monitor the onboarding process and gather feedback
- Work out technical kinks
- Ask participants for detailed feedback via surveys or interviews
- Run improvements throughout the test period

## Phase 5: Public Launch

**Develop a Marketing Strategy**
- Use a multichannel approach (email, direct mail, phone, social media)
- Prioritize email and online solicitations (easiest for donors to set up recurring gifts)
- Create a detailed marketing plan with interconnected channels

**Leverage Social Proof**
- Use testimonials and positive feedback from soft launch participants
- Share compelling statistics about program impact
- Feature positive responses in marketing materials

**Create Urgency**
- Offer time-sensitive incentives (e.g., corporate matching for first month in a specific month)
- Set deadlines for special founder recognition

**Personalize Outreach**
- Use donor management software to identify candidates
- Send personalized communications explaining benefits
- Reach out directly to your most dedicated supporter segments

## Phase 6: Ongoing Engagement & Growth

**Build Community**
- Develop automatic email templates to invite donors to increase giving after 18 months
- Create incentives for longevity (anniversary recognition, special updates)
- Send exclusive content to monthly donors (impact reports, behind-the-scenes updates)

**Promote Continuously**
- Include monthly giving options on print forms
- Leverage social media to engage younger generations
- Highlight the program at fundraising events (galas, etc.)

**Maintain Relationships**
- Send prompt, automatic acknowledgments and receipts
- Provide regular impact updates showing how their recurring gifts make a difference
- Keep communication consistent and meaningful

---

## Key Takeaways

✓ **Start with your best supporters** — board members, volunteers, long-term donors  
✓ **Focus on impact messaging** — not the mechanics of how to give  
✓ **Make the process simple** — mobile-friendly forms, clear giving levels, easy setup  
✓ **Test before full launch** — gather feedback and refine  
✓ **Use multiple channels** — but prioritize email and online  
✓ **Offer flexibility** — custom giving amounts and easy management options  
✓ **Build community** — recognize donors and provide ongoing engagement
